comment: Read from the maker's source at commit 7dc3dab, doc/manual.md, and the maker's own ChowTape plugin manual at chowdsp.com. All three knobs are 0 to 1 shown as a percentage and all three default to 0. The two ends are special cases in cookParams: at frequency 0 the dropout mix is 0 and the filter is opened to 22000Hz, and at frequency 1 the dropout is on permanently. In between, the module toggles between chewed and clean stretches whose lengths come from getWetTime and getDryTime, both of which draw a random number scaled by the variance knob. The dropout power is one plus up to three times the depth knob, and the filter during a chewed stretch runs from 22000Hz down to 5000Hz as the depth knob rises.
